# Aegryn: Swiss firm of entrepreneurs, advisory and signature projects
> https://aegryn.com | Updated: 2026-10-16

Aegryn (pronounced AY-grin /ˈeɪ.grɪn/) is a Swiss firm of entrepreneurs ("cabinet d'entrepreneurs", "architecte de projets emblématiques"). It frames, delivers and accompanies the decisions and projects of leaders of SMEs and mid-sized companies, and runs La Boutique, an entrepreneurial boutique for a limited number of signature projects.

Signature: "Rare by selection. Discreet by principle." (FR: "Rare par sélection. Discret par principe.") and "Anchored in Switzerland, open to the world." (FR: "Ancré en Suisse, ouvert à l'international.")

Aegryn is NOT a marketplace, auction house, catalogue, buyer or seller platform, or transaction platform. Earlier catalogue, auction and transaction pages (/transact/*) are archived and redirect to the home page. Aegryn advises and delivers; financial execution of transactions is entrusted to accredited partners.

## Identity

- Type: integrated advisory and delivery firm, incorporated in Switzerland, HQ St-Sulpice (canton of Vaud), 46.5147, 6.5600
- Two voices: the integrated firm (eight advisory disciplines, menu "Nos métiers") and La Boutique (/boutique, signature projects)
- Clients: leaders and decision-makers of SMEs and mid-sized companies; investors and family offices; entrepreneurs; institutions and large groups; industrials and brands
- Way of working: one named contact, a limited number of mandates at a time, a reply within two working days, independent network experts coordinated when a subject requires it, a confidentiality agreement before any detailed exchange
- Aegryn does not itself carry out heavy industrial production or physical manufacturing; it steers specialist partners who do
- Contact: contact@boha-group.com, +41 24 539 18 81 (Swiss office), https://aegryn.com/en/contact
- Languages: French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch (/fr, /en, /de, /es, /it, /nl)

## Five public ways of working

1. Frame (FR: Cadrer): decide on documented grounds. Strategy, risk, finance, technology, operations, talent, M&A.
2. Deliver (FR: Réaliser): steer projects and programmes from governance to acceptance, with you and for you.
3. Accompany (FR: Accompagner): every life cycle of the company: launch, growth, restructuring, acquisition, transfer.
4. Select (FR: Sélectionner): key and transition profiles, executives and experts.
5. Stay informed (FR: S'informer): Aegryn Magazine, articles and market data.

CIFSO is the certification, protocol and tooling infrastructure behind the firm. It is not a public offer of its own.

## Eight advisory disciplines
- [Our eight disciplines](https://aegryn.com/en/advisory): hub page
- [Business Strategy and Innovation](https://aegryn.com/en/advisory/strategy): growth strategy, innovation, board advisory
- [Risk Management and Compliance](https://aegryn.com/en/advisory/risk-compliance): NIS2, DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR and Swiss FADP, incident readiness
- [Finance and Performance](https://aegryn.com/en/advisory/finance-performance): cash, profitability, financing readiness, interim finance leadership
- [Technology and Sovereignty](https://aegryn.com/en/advisory/technology): cybersecurity, AI audit, cloud independence, implementation
- [Operations and Operational Excellence](https://aegryn.com/en/advisory/operations-excellence): operating model, process performance, supply chain
- [Talent and Organization](https://aegryn.com/en/advisory/talent-organization): organisation design, founder dependency, succession
- [Project and Programme Management](https://aegryn.com/en/advisory/project-program-management): governance to acceptance
- [M&A, Transactions and PMI](https://aegryn.com/en/advisory/ma): preparation, due diligence reading, post-merger integration

## La Boutique (signature projects)
- [La Boutique](https://aegryn.com/en/boutique): the entrepreneurial boutique. Method: Frame, Deliver, Accompany. Six values: exceptional, exclusivity, confidentiality, trust, experience, elegance. Four audiences: entrepreneurs; investors and family offices; institutions and organisations; industrials and brands.
- [Signature projects](https://aegryn.com/en/boutique/projets): portfolio (neediu, Movtoo, Primiom, Hobconnect, Heritix, Chrosium, Insertdry)
- [Contact for a project](https://aegryn.com/en/contact?subject=project): a confidentiality agreement precedes any detailed exchange, personal reply within two working days

## Select, network and partners
- [Aegryn Talent](https://aegryn.com/en/talent): key profile selection, transition profiles, candidate pool ([companies](https://aegryn.com/en/talent/entreprises), [candidates](https://aegryn.com/en/talent/candidats), [transition](https://aegryn.com/en/talent/transition))
- [Expert network](https://aegryn.com/en/experts): independent experts coordinated by Aegryn, eleven expertise domains (the eight disciplines, Board Advisory, Executive Search, Signature projects)
- [Become a partner](https://aegryn.com/en/alliances): domain experts, investors and institutions, independent CIFSO auditors
- [Investors and institutions](https://aegryn.com/en/investisseurs): an operating partner for portfolio companies

## Certification and valuation (CIFSO)
- [CIFSO 5000 certification](https://aegryn.com/en/grade): independent certification of the value and transferability of an organisation, 5 dimensions scored /100 (Code and Architecture, IP and Rights, Finance and Metrics, Security, Sovereignty and AI Exposure, Organisation, Talent and Succession), grades AEG, AAA, AA, A, B, certificate valid twelve months
- [CIFSO 5000 brochure](https://aegryn.com/en/grade/brochure), [submit an organisation](https://aegryn.com/en/grade/submit), [independent auditors](https://aegryn.com/en/audit), [verify a certificate](https://aegryn.com/en/verify)
- [CIFSO Valuation Index](https://aegryn.com/en/valuation): benchmark of market multiples per industry; the free estimate is illustrative and does not replace certification
- Confidentiality: a mutual, fully digital NDA (no user account needed) is sent manually by Aegryn to a named contact; Aegryn countersigns automatically. Access to certification evidence and data-room sections requires both a signed NDA and manual activation by Aegryn.
- [Proprietary assets](https://aegryn.com/en/assets): Subblink (AI contract analysis, https://subblink.com) and the products designed and operated by the group

## Inform
- [Aegryn Magazine](https://aegryn.com/en/magazine): quarterly, English, "Tech. Money. Deals. People. Life." Edition January 2027 "Built to Last" ([issue](https://aegryn.com/en/magazine/issue-01), [web reader](https://aegryn.com/en/magazine/issue-01/web))
- [Blog](https://aegryn.com/en/blog): market analyses and guides for Swiss and European leaders, in six languages
- [Employment and skills data](https://aegryn.com/en/workforce): AI and labour-market data (World Economic Forum, PwC)
- [FAQ](https://aegryn.com/en/help/faq): 19 answers, including whether Aegryn is a marketplace (it is not), La Boutique and the NDA
